selection: first six existing development queries in file order; no outcome or GT selection
initialization: agents start in a half selected by SHA256(video_id + query); independent of GT
primary: paired top1 temporal IoU and R1@0.5 on all six queries, failures count as zero
recovery: conditional results when the initialized half has zero GT overlap; eligibility computed only after rollout
claims: development feasibility pilot, no QA accuracy labels, no learned policy, no VTS reproduction, no significance claim
stop: no retries; stop new requests after three consecutive API failures; preserve full denominator
